text:
Priya: Postmortem follow-up from the 3/18 canary incident. Pattern: slow regressions ~30–90m after rollout. Proposals: auto-rollback on rate-of-change spikes, stricter blast-radius limits, and a quarantine window on deploys. Need owners + timelines.
Mike: I can take auto-rollback. Thinking: trigger when error_rate increases >3% over 5m AND error_rate >1% absolute, or p95 latency jump >40% over baseline. Proposed action: implement staged rollback policy and add an opt-in for aggressive mode. 
Asha: For feature flags we should add "cohort_scope" tag so flags can be limited to org/account/region. Also add a max cohort size default 5%.
Tom: +1 on quarantine window. My idea: post-deploy "quarantine" for first 30m where autoscaling is disabled and any anomaly pauses further rollout. Also add a 'manual continue' button in console.
Miguel: I'll own blast-radius changes. Action: update rollout config schema -> add fields: `max_initial_percent`, `quarantine_minutes`, `rollback_thresholds`. I'll open INF-2298 and link dashboards.
sre-bot: INF-2298 created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-2298 :white_check_mark:
Priya: Timeline: owners assign PRs by EOD Thu, implement tests + canary sim by next Tue, staging rollout Wed. Owners confirm here.
Mike: I'll open a PR for the rollback controller today. Draft threshold config in `infra/rollout/defaults.yaml`:
```
rollback:
  error_rate_pct_delta: 3
  absolute_error_rate_pct: 1
  p95_multiplier: 1.4
```
Asha: I'll add flag scoping to the SDK and add tests. Expect PR by Mon.
Tom: I'll add console button and quarantine UI. Need design help @Asha :eyes:
Miguel: Dashboards: I'll add canary drift panel + alert - will reuse existing latency/time-series template.
Priya: Great. Owners: please post PR links and ETA updates in this thread. I'll compile action tracker and ping PM + Security for review. :thumbsup:
Mike: ack :thumbsup:
Asha: ack
Tom: ack
Miguel: ack
